Name: Surplus
Effect: +1 deployable charge: Wall, Healing zone or Turret

Name: Relay
Effect: Dash snaps to your nearest deployable within 30 degrees of the dash; no direction moves you toward the nearest one

Name: Split
Effect: Deploy has a 25% chance to place a half-health copy next to it

Name: Bond
Effect: Link to allies: you absorb 15% of the damage they take

Name: Wake
Effect: Dash spawns your deployable at the start point (max 1 per 8 s)

Name: Kinship
Effect: When your deployable dies, it spawns one of your ally's (max 1 per 5 s)

Name: Leverage
Effect: Deployable health x0.7 close up to x1.3 at max deploy distance
